title: Finite reductions of the counit-normalized integral pullback compositor
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite, and S an IntegralComparisonSystem [def-sf-integral-comparison-system-data]. For every composable pair h:Z→W, k:W→V with l invertible, every constructible integral K, and every allowed good representative of K and k* K, the finite reduction at exponent n+1 of integralComparisonComposition S h k, followed by rho_h and h* rho_k, equals rho_(h k) followed by the published finite compositor. Here rho is integralPullbackReductionIso [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition] and the finite compositor is [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition].

source.place: First paragraph, composition and coefficient extension of pullbacks

proof.text: Choose a simultaneous strict presentation of the reduction of a flat-term K-flat representative. Apply the pullback model normalization to identify realization on this presentation with the specified Roos comparison. By adjunction the whole-system counit is the reduction comparison; its finite evaluations are the actual rho maps. Naturality makes the result independent of the chosen good representatives.

source.place: First paragraph, composition and coefficient extension of pullbacks

proof.text: Substitute the normalized counits in eta and the definition of integralComparisonComposition. Cancel the reconstruction unit and counit by the adjunction triangle in the whole derived system category. Evaluate at n: the normalized sequence compositor is the finite canonical pullback compositor. Pasting gives the asserted equality; no faithfulness of separate reductions is invoked.

theorem integralComparisonComposition_reduction
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (S : IntegralComparisonSystem.{u} l) :
    ∀ {V W Z : Scheme.{u}}
        [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
        [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
        [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
        (h : Z ⟶ W) (k : W ⟶ V) (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E V)
        (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E V).FullSubcategory)
        (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj ≅ K.obj)
        (Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory)
        (d : DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj ≅ ((constructibleIntegralPullback l E k).obj K).obj)
        (n : ℕ),
        (scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E Z n).map
            (integralComparisonComposition l E S h k K).hom ≫
            (integralPullbackReductionIso l E h
              ((constructibleIntegralPullback l E k).obj K) Q d n).hom ≫
            (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback
              (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) h).map
                (integralPullbackReductionIso l E k K P e n).hom =
          (integralPullbackReductionIso l E (h ≫ k) K P e n).hom ≫
            (integralFiniteCanonicalPullbackComposition l E h k n).hom.app
              ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E V n).obj K.obj)
